summary: Round 3 of T7-03 passes. All five story checks exit 0 when run exactly as listed. I read the root layout, banners, header, footer and page-check.ts. The round-2 blocker (codex-r2-1) is fixed: page-check.ts now compares each banner's whole block text, not just its text runs. I found no blocker or high finding. I did not reproduce the gzip -9 initial-JS figure, because the review permission rules forbid the loop it needs.

checks.evidence: Ruff, mypy, and the turbo lint and typecheck tasks all pass. Exit 0. The turbo results were cache hits.

pytest: 404 passed. Web: 256 passed, including tests/page-check.test.ts (37), tests/site-layout.test.tsx (32) and components/mode-banner.test.tsx (14). Schema: 157 passed. The turbo results were cache hits.
The build compiled. Routes / and /_not-found are both ○ Static.
Output: 'web-smoke: GET http://127.0.0.1:65285/ (prerendered) shows the mock banner, "Shipping mode: not chosen (G0 NOT_RUN)" and bundle version mock-0 in the footer'.

checks.criterion: AC1 mode banner and mock banner texts
checks.evidence: components/mode-banner.tsx:10-21 holds the three titles. They match PRD.md:168-170 word for word. For a null mode the banner is the shellText line, which web-smoke shows as 'not chosen (G0 NOT_RUN)'. The mock banner at components/mock-banner.tsx:9-10 renders nothing when the text is null. The mode-banner vitest passes.

app/layout.tsx:28-38 renders the skip link, the header (mock banner, mode banner, navigation), a single <main id tabIndex=-1> and the footer. The footer reads 'Bundle version: <v> · Schema <v>' (site-footer.tsx:9). That differs from the literal 'Bundle <v>' in AC2. The orchestrator decision and T0-05's smoke assertions require this wording; see finding 1.
site-header.tsx:11-19 lists Home, /explore/moon, /explore/mars, /explore/earth, /model, /methods and /data as next/link. No /api/docs, /paper, /probe or /compare link.

Plain anchors in a ul in DOM order. aria-current='page' only when pathname === href (site-header.tsx:27-33). The focus ring comes from the global CSS, which tests/contrast.ts checks. I did not run a browser to check it.

checks.criterion: AC5 Mode B/C wording and the / line
checks.evidence: The banner adds only the PRD 4 title. HOME_LINE is 'These pages show records from the bundle named in the footer.' (page-check.ts:11). It states no numbers or claims.

checks.criterion: AC6 static rendering and page-check.ts update
checks.evidence: / is ○ Static in the build output. page-check.ts applies the exact-text rule to <main> (lines 165-176). The mock banner, mode banner and footer are still asserted exactly: the banners as whole block text (118-123, 146, 152) and the footer as the whole <footer> text (158-164). The once-only 'Shipping mode:' count and the 'Mock bundle' check for non-mock bundles are kept. The mock-in-production guard is not in the changed paths.

checks.criterion: AC8 single client component and JS budget
checks.evidence: The single client component is confirmed by reading: only site-header.tsx has 'use client'. The layout, banners and footer have no directive. The gzip -9 sum of the initial scripts needs a loop, which the permission rules forbid, so I did not reproduce the 177,190 B figure. The rounds 1 and 2 rebuttals report a reproduced total of 177,190 B, which is +3,216 B over the 173,974 B baseline and within the 250 kB budget.

findings.claim: AC2 literally says 'Bundle <bundle_version>', but the footer reads 'Bundle version: <v> · Schema <v>'.
findings.evidence: web-smoke asserts 'bundle version mock-0' from T0-05's shellText. The wording follows the documented orchestrator decision and smoke compatibility, so it is a literal-reading difference only.

findings.claim: The gzip -9 initial-JS measurement of 177,190 B was not independently reproduced in this round.
findings.evidence: The command needs a shell loop, which the review permission rules forbid. The build output shows / as static, and site-header.tsx is the only 'use client' file in the story's files.
